units.source_text: 这一天，三公主处他也不到，只派人送一封信去。

en.t: That day, he did not even go to the Third Princess, but only sent someone with a letter for her.

units.source_text: 镇日在家里把衣服用心地加以熏香，直到天黑。

en.t: He spent the whole day at home carefully perfuming his robes with incense, until night fell.

units.source_text: 黄昏过后，他只带四五个亲信随从，打扮成从前微行时的模样，乘坐一辆竹席车，往二条院去了。

en.t: After dusk, taking only four or five trusted attendants, he dressed as he used to when going out incognito, rode in a carriage fitted with bamboo blinds, and went to the Nijo estate.

units.source_text: 到了宫邸，叫前和泉守进去通报。

en.t: When he arrived at the palace residence, he had the former Governor of Izumi go in and announce him.

units.source_text: 侍女悄悄地把源氏来访的消息告知胧月夜。

en.t: A lady-in-waiting quietly informed Oborozukiyo that Genji had come to visit.

units.source_text: 胧月夜吃了一惊，皱着眉头说道：“真奇怪！

en.t: Oborozukiyo was startled and said with a frown, "How strange!

units.source_text: 不知和泉守怎样回复他的。”

en.t: I wonder how the Governor of Izumi answered him."

units.source_text: 侍女说：“倘随便捏造借口，打发他回去，毕竟太没有礼貌了。”

en.t: The lady-in-waiting said, "If we simply invent some excuse and send him away, it would be far too discourteous."

units.source_text: 便自作主张，把源氏请了进来。

en.t: So, acting on her own judgment, she invited Genji in.

units.source_text: 源氏把慰问的来意叫侍女传达之后，又说：“务请尚侍移玉来此，隔帘晤谈亦可。

en.t: After having the lady-in-waiting convey that he had come to pay his respects, Genji added, "Please ask the Naishi no Kami to come here; speaking through a curtain would be enough.

units.source_text: 往年那种非礼之心，今已消除净尽了。”

en.t: The improper feelings I had in former years have now been entirely put away."

units.source_text: 他再三恳请，胧月夜只得唉声叹气地膝行而出。

en.t: As he pleaded again and again, Oborozukiyo had no choice but to sigh and shuffle forward on her knees.

units.source_text: 源氏一边高兴，一边又想：“果然不出我之所料：她还是同从前一样容易亲近的。”

en.t: Genji was pleased, and at the same time thought, "Just as I expected: she is still as approachable as she was before."

units.source_text: 两人虽然隔开，但非泛泛之交，互相听见动作之声，各自不胜感慨之情。

en.t: Though the two were separated, theirs was no casual bond, and merely hearing each other's movements filled them both with deep emotion.

units.source_text: 这里是东厅，源氏的客座设在东南角上的厢房中，通厢房的纸隔扇上加锁。

en.t: This was the eastern hall; Genji's guest seat had been prepared in the side room at the southeast corner, and the paper partition leading to it was locked.

units.source_text: 源氏恨恨地说：“如此布置，很像是招待一个少年人呢！

en.t: Genji said resentfully, "This arrangement is just like receiving some young boy!

units.source_text: 别来多少年月，我都记得清楚。

en.t: I remember clearly how many years and months have passed since we parted.

units.source_text: 待我如此冷淡，未免无情太甚了！”

en.t: To treat me so coldly is really far too heartless!"

units.source_text: 此时夜已很深，鸳鸯在池塘里荇藻间浮游，其鸣声十分凄凉。

en.t: By then the night was very late, and mandarin ducks drifted among the water plants in the pond, their calls sounding deeply forlorn.

units.source_text: 源氏看了邸内阴气沉沉、人影疏疏的景象，觉得与当年弘徽殿太后在世之时大不相同，感慨之极，流下泪来。

en.t: Seeing the gloomy residence and the sparse figures within it, Genji felt how different it was from the days when the Empress Mother of Kokiden was alive, and in overwhelming emotion he shed tears.

units.source_text: 这倒不是模仿平仲，却是真的眼泪。

en.t: These were not tears shed in imitation of Heichu, but genuine tears.

units.source_text: 源氏现在不像从前那样浮躁了，出言十分稳重。

en.t: Genji was no longer as flighty as he had been before, and his words were very composed.

units.source_text: 此时却伸手拉动纸隔扇，希望把它拉开。

en.t: Yet now he reached out and tugged at the paper partition, hoping to slide it open.

units.source_text: 随即赋诗云：

en.t: He immediately composed a poem and recited:
